title: QUIZ - 31
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Simplify an expression requiring both the product and quotient rules for exponents
questions.question: Simplify: \( ( 2^2 \times 2^2 ) \div 2^1 \)
questions.explanation: First combine the numerator using the product rule: \(2^{2} \times 2^{2} = 2^{4}\). Then apply the quotient rule: \(2^{4} \div 2^{1} = 2^{3}\).
questions.hint: Apply the product rule first, then the quotient rule, combining exponents by addition and subtraction.

questions.learningObjective: Apply the product rule to simplify a product of powers with the same base
questions.question: Simplify: \( 2^3 \times 2^6 \)
questions.explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: \(2^{3} \times 2^{6} = 2^{9}\).
questions.hint: To multiply powers with the same base, keep the base and add the exponents.

questions.learningObjective: Apply the quotient rule to simplify a quotient of powers with the same base
questions.question: Simplify: \( 5^6 \div 5^5 \)
questions.explanation: When dividing powers with the same base, subtract the exponents: \(5^{6} \div 5^{5} = 5^{1}\).
questions.hint: To divide powers with the same base, keep the base and subtract the exponents.
